title: Avalanche Academy Workshop – Blockchain & Web3 Fundamentals | Build on Avalanche
description:
Avalanche Academy Workshop – Blockchain & Web3 Fundamentals is an educational webinar hosted by the Computer Science Society in partnership with Team1, held on October 29, 2025 (7:00 PM–10:00 PM).

This workshop provides an introduction to blockchain technology, Web3 development, and the Avalanche ecosystem, designed especially for students, beginner developers, and aspiring Web3 builders.

Participants gained insights into:

Blockchain and Web3 fundamentals

Building decentralized applications (dApps)

The Avalanche blockchain ecosystem

Web3 career paths and innovation opportunities for students

🎙 Featured Speakers:

Federico Nardelli – Developer Relations, Avalanche Team1

Doro Unger-Lee – Senior Developer Relations (University Partnerships), Ava Labs

Rommel – Team1 Philippines Tech Lead

This recorded session aims to empower students and developers to start building on Avalanche, explore Web3 technologies, and understand real-world blockchain applications.

📌 Watch the full workshop to learn the fundamentals of blockchain and Web3 from industry experts.
